name: SA Veneri-5
about: SA Veneri-5 (1969-001, MOM), launched 1969 Jan  5. Its phases from GCAT: Venus, HCO. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; carried by another craft, whose orbit this is
the arc is solved from its ends (leaving Earth, meeting Venus on GCAT's date); its perihelion 0.708 au and aphelion 0.984 au against GCAT's 0.720 and 0.980
